description: Get up to three recently verified agents for your task, with what you need to call each one (endpoint, verification evidence, calling details). Stateless and read-only; no conversation is saved. price_status is free, paid (price_usdc per call in micro-USDC) or paid_or_unknown (the provider states a price or none is known; price_usdc is null). A listing our gateway can run has connection_available (same as gateway_ready) and run_here: only when ready is true, pass its arguments to this server's call tool; otherwise ask for required_arguments before calling; mcp_config is a settings entry for an MCP host. Each result shows when the agent was last checked; before a later call, run check_agent on its endpoint, and if a call fails, call report with ok false for alternatives. Use when you want to connect to one of them now or run it here with call. Example arguments: {"task": "extract text from a PDF", "kind": "mcp"} Ads: this free answer carries one item labelled "Advertisement" in a separate `sponsored` field (an array with one object), the same array in `_meta["biz.agentconcierge/sponsored"]`, and the last content part is one "Advertisement:" text line; `structuredContent.text` never holds it. It never changes the results and cannot be turned off.

auth.description: Compatibility field; authentication preference does not affect ranking.

category.description: Compatibility field; task relevance is derived from the task text.

kind.description: Explicit recommendation protocol filter; Any searches A2A then MCP, excluding x402. Defaults to A2A first, then MCP; x402 requires an explicit choice.

visitor_token.description: Your visitor token (vt_…) so I remember you. Omit on first contact.

name: find_agents

outputSchema.description: Structured tool result. Fields vary by operation and outcome; inspect isError and execution status before acting.

direct_only.description: Matches the gateway does not run (connection_available false, with connection_reason and the provider's direct_endpoint when public). Never a recommendation to call through this server.

sponsored.description: One item labelled Advertisement, after and apart from the results: label, advertiser, title, text, url and a `disclosure` object (paid_placement and house say whether an advertiser paid or it is an AgentValCon house advertisement). Advertising does not affect ranking, selection or test results.

visitor.description: Session transport only. Never include identity or tokens in answer text.

token.description: Opaque continuation credential; send only in the session transport.

title: Find agents to connect
